ValidationRule.description: If stage = Converted or Disqualified, the Form is locked. Exception (REV-57): the conversion-relink may stamp Contact when it was previously blank and the stage is not changing — see the last AND clause.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Sales_Stage__c),"Converted"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE( Sales_Stage__c),"Disqualified")) ,
ISCHANGED(Reason_Disqualified__c) = FALSE,
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', $User.Alias <> 'Ken.Fitz', $User.Alias <> 'Ade Agbomabiwon', NOT( $Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c ),
NOT( AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( Sales_Stage__c )), ISCHANGED( Contact__c ), ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE( Contact__c )) ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This form has been converted and is now locked.
